fields.why: The disputed entry is the priority-audience ranking (transgender women, Black MSM, Hispanic MSM, Black cisgender women). The article's gender variable is 'a composite of reported sex at birth and current gender identity', so SOGI already covers the cisgender women vs MSM split (A); adding sex (B) is defensible but double-counts one composite variable. Lean A.

brief_issues: groupwise/equity: the brief does not say how to code a composite sex-at-birth/gender-identity variable (cisgender man, cisgender woman, transgender groups); a rule such as 'code a composite gender-identity variable as SOGI only, not also sex' would decide it.
